Rusiru Rathmina is a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, building robust full-stack solutions for modern web applications. He specializes in developing high-performance web applications, RESTful APIs, and enterprise solutions using Java, Spring Boot, React, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
LEAD FEATURE · FULL-STACK SOLUTIONS FOR MODERN WEB
Building Robust, Scalable, and User-Centric Applications as a Full-Stack Software Engineer & Problem Solver.

Specializing in high-performance web apps, RESTful APIs, and enterprise solutions that help businesses scale.

Rusiru Rathmina is a Software Engineer with professional experience spanning full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, application security, and DevOps. He works at Omobio (Pvt) Ltd in Colombo, Sri Lanka, and has contributed to enterprise platforms including Dialog.lk and Dialog BizCare for Dialog Axiata PLC. His expertise includes Java, Spring Boot, React.js, PHP, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Colombo School of Computing (UCSC) with a GPA of 3.01.

Hello! I'm Rusiru Rathmina, a Software Engineer at Omobio (Pvt) Ltd, specializing in Full-Stack Development, Cloud Computing, and DevOps.

My journey began as a trainee, and I have since grown into designing scalable solutions using Java, Spring Boot, React, and AWS. I have extensive hands-on experience refactoring legacy systems and building secure, reliable applications.

My expertise covers the full lifecycle—from frontend design with React.js to backend logic in PHP/Drupal and infrastructure management using Docker and Kubernetes.

I am always open to collaborating on Full-Stack or DevOps projects. Let's connect and shape the future of technology together!
